All five `ShortcutService` RPCs are declared in `proto/api/v1/shortcut_service.proto` and implemented on `APIV1Service` in `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go`:

| RPC | Line |
|---|---|
| `ListShortcuts` | 49 |
| `GetShortcut` | 95 |
| `CreateShortcut` | 135 |
| `UpdateShortcut` | 211 |
| `DeleteShortcut` | 284 |

`ConnectServiceHandler` in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` wraps these methods but delegates to `APIV1Service`; the business logic lives in `shortcut_service.go`.
